heroHeadline: Iran 'Reviewing' US MOU Response — 'Reduced the Gaps'; Pakistan Field Marshal Munir in Tehran; Trump-Netanyahu Rift Over Iran Strategy Widens; Day 83
heroSubtitle: Day 83 (May 21): Iran's Foreign Ministry confirmed Tehran is formally reviewing the latest US MOU response, with spokesman Baghaei saying it has 'reduced the gaps to some extent' — the most positive Iranian diplomatic signal since talks began. Bloomberg reported Iran said the US offer has 'narrowed the gaps.' FM Araghchi delivered deliberate strategic ambiguity: 'wherever necessary to fight, we will fight, and wherever necessary to negotiate, we will negotiate.' Pakistan's Field Marshal Asim Munir arrived in Tehran for the highest-level Pakistani visit since the April 8 ceasefire, escalating the mediation effort. On Day 82 (May 20), Trump and Netanyahu held a tense phone call — CNN reported Netanyahu's 'hair was on fire' as he lobbied for military strikes; Trump chose the diplomacy track and publicly stated Netanyahu will 'do whatever I want.' Trump also softened his ultimatum to 'a few more days.' CNN cited US intelligence sources reporting Iran is rebuilding its military-industrial base 'faster than expected.' IDF strikes killed 20+ in southern Lebanon on Day 83; Lebanon's cumulative toll passes 3,073.
